a.text: Since our scrap with Ulšulah, they've tightened defenses around that cave. W and her bombs helped us get out once, but that may not work a second time.
We haven't been able to get close again. But I'm sure the 'drifting bones' haven't returned yet.
That is, I was sure until we all had the same dream.
The ash-bleached city engulfed in flames, the shattered walls, the charred corpses piled in every corner.
The city did not leave with the dream until we opened our eyes.
The flames trampled every settlement, every clan.
The place we called Kazdel no longer exists, only fire and ruin remain.
The despairing giant knelt down and wept.

steps.name: Sarkaz?
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) The King of Sarkaz is dead.

steps.name: Sarkaz?
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) The King killed the King.

steps.name: Sarkaz?
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) Why? This should not be...

steps.name: Sarkaz?
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) Our city, Kazdel...

steps.name: Sarkaz?
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) This would be a curse! A curse engraved upon the crown...

steps.name: Sarkaz?
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) This would be... the beginning of the end of all...

a.text: That Feranmut has returned.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Tomorrow morning, the attack begins.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Siege and her Exemplars will be responsible for the perimeter. Us, the Rhodes rabbit and the Banshee have to get deep into that waystation.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Where's that old bitch Kal'tsit? She's sending us off on this suicide mission without making so much as a cameo appearance?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Her injuries have not yet healed. Ascalon will look after her and the Doctor. They will stay behind.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Rhodes Island recently came under Confessarius attack, they were trying to take the bunny's crown.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmph, the crown.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hoederer... you didn't tell the Victorians the truth.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If your plan works, and we go back to Kazdel, what are you gonna do?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Even your new Victorian friends are probably not gonna be okay with you bundling 'war criminals' in with 'Sarkaz caught up in the war'.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't tell me you vowed to bring the Sarkaz home but never thought through this little problem?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Like, are you gonna head off to teach a class on 'historical reflections' to this bunch of grunts dragged off the battlefield? In that Kazdel basement university?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe I'll start a literacy class there. Make sure future Sarkaz have fewer illiterates like W here.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Do my ears deceive me? Did Hoederer actually make a joke out of Ines's words? On such a serious topic?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What happened? Did sucking up to General Manfred teach you a little emotional intelligence?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: 'War's over, back to Kazdel.' Real funny, we're actually fantasizing about this stuff here.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We're mercs, and that's all we're ever gonna be.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're such a lovely Caprinae, Ines, maybe you could run off to Leithanien and become a governess for some hoity toity nobles in a big, tall tower.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You could teach... Let me think... how to keep your hair nice and silky in a war zone? How's that sound?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Not interested.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What are you daydreaming about? The battle's about to start.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No, I just...

a.text: Ines's gaze shifts down to my feet ever so slightly.
She's looking at my shadow again. What is it showing?
I don't know myself. I'm rarely so... calm before an op.
Calm gives me a chance to think about all sorts of things.
A few trivial things.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I remember you said you wanted to open a shop in Kazdel.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Because I didn't have a place to fence stolen goods at the time.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Oh yeah.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: How about we use the first round of tuition from my literacy class for your startup capital?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I doubt that class is gonna earn you much.

steps.name: W
steps.text: On the other hand, kidnapping a Leithanian governess could fetch a decent ransom. Gotta be at least as much as ten merc heads.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Let's talk about it when we make it home for real.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Your mental state has me worrying if you can really handle this mission.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Did those illusions or the Arts Circles drive you mad?

a.text: Maybe they did.
In this moment of extreme calm, some tendrils of unease irritate my heart, causing hesitation.
Amidst my own surprising thoughts, I find the reason for my anxiety.
I'm worried they won't accept me. Because of my...
Some of my ideas.
But I have to speak. The arrow is nocked.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Pay no attention to this mopey idiot.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Time waits for no man. Once we stake the Vampire and behead Theresis, then you two can head on back to Kazdel and talk over all the interior decorating plans for your love nest.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Theresis.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've been thinking about this for a while, W. You may not like what I'm about to say, but I still have to say it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah, throwing cold water on me before the fight?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Pretty much.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We can't kill Theresis, at least not right here or now, it can't be the Sarkaz executing him.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ines was right, those illusions did scramble your brains.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Killing him means no Kazdel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Whether now or for a good long while after the war, he has to be recorded as the Regent... and even be praised by some.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Are you out of your mind?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I really don't feel like joking about this.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We still need to stop the war, and I haven't changed my mind.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But Theresis has taken his place as a cornerstone of the Sarkaz future.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Kazdel won't survive another split, and this war... it can't end with another Sarkaz betrayal, with another Sarkaz civil war.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Remember the plan I was talking about before? We need the Sarkaz here to pull out of Victoria before everyone hears about his death.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Once everyone knows the Sarkaz have failed, and the threat of Theresis is gone, what happens then?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The dukes will slaughter every last Sarkaz in Victoria without mercy. The revenge killings will spread to other countries in centrum, and all civilization will have a justifiable excuse... to exterminate the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: They'll put together a coalition, just and reasonable, swift and decisive... to divide up all of Theresa's and Theresis's legacies.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Can't you picture that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: To be honest, I don't give a shit about any consequences of Theresis dying. All I'm here for is the part where he dies.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Coalitions? Slaughtering Sarkaz? Weren't they doing that already?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Does Theresis dying mean all the devils are just gonna lose their will to fight back?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah, no way. I don't buy that.

steps.name: W
steps.text: He sent the assassins to kill Theresa, declared himself king, and dragged all of us into the mess we're in today.

steps.name: W
steps.text: We don't need to sacrifice ourselves for his Kazdel, for his—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Don't think you can keep yourself out of it, W.

a.text: I thought I was gonna really let her have it, really tear into W, this... sad woman.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Do you think of yourself as nothing more than a merc?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: How many people have you brought? From Reunion to where we stand now, how many Sarkaz have you gathered?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're carrying their lives on your shoulders.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't fucking care!

a.text: But W is wavering.
I know her too well. It's not like she hasn't thought about it, she isn't an uncaring leader at all.
Looking at it objectively, a whole lot of mercs have stepped up to follow this madwoman.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You have to care.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You think you can just keep on killing people, keep on burying bombs in the dirt?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're leading those Sarkaz now. You have to think about how to deal with their hopes and dreams.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You have to think through what their lives mean to you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But I—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: It's not just Theresis—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't forget, there's Theresa too.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So, from all perspectives we're... all we can be is their successors, the inheritors of their ideals.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The two of them, they're the reason the Sarkaz could come together in the first place.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's not the real Theresa.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's a fake Theresis has cooked up. He can't fool me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Look at yourself.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Who do you think you are—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You couldn't accept Theresa's death, you're stuck in the shadow of Babel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Like...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You think Amiya's walking ahead of you. You think she's Theresa's handpicked successor, that the King of Sarkaz should be thinking about this stuff.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You look at her and see another Theresa, you think all you need to do is follow the King.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Shut up! Are you trying to gross me out?!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You think you don't deserve to inherit anything.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What kind of joke is this? You think you get me? You're my mentor now, you're gonna raise me, teach me, huh Hoederer?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're just a merc, not much higher on the ladder than me. But you're so deluded you can stand up and call yourself a successor or whatever of whatever?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ugh, it's so gross! The little bunny? I'm gonna follow her?

steps.name: W
steps.text: She was in the right place at the right time to be chosen—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: —Chosen by Theresa, to become the leader of Rhodes Island who stopped Reunion and Talulah, who broke her way into Londinium today.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So what about you, W?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What exactly does Theresa mean to you?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Some distant ethereal symbol who once gave you a place to stay, one specific flesh-and-blood royal, or—the path she stood for?

steps.name: W
steps.text: 'For this land to... fall into peaceful slumber.'

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Ugh.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So... that's why I say she's a fake.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ines... how have you managed to hold back from killing him this long?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Because I'm not deluding myself, most of the time.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ugh. Spare me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whatever, Hoederer.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know what I have to do. And I'm not going to kill you to shake up morale this time, you should be kissing my feet.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Polish that sword of yours good, we've got a war tomorrow.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sigh... she ran off again.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Do you really think she could be a decent leader?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's organized a whole lot of mercs.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Heh, are they really 'mercs' though?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: How much money does W have to hire them? And how much does she earn for them with the things she does?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Alright then, why are they following her?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No matter what she says, whether it's revenge for Theresa, hunting down the assassins, or just randomly bombing her way across the land—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's definitely... walked her path.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The ones who follow her really are sad.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But people forget how young she is. She's got lots of... room for improvement.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We can hope.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Also, the startup capital for your shop, not a joke.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Exemplars is fully equipped.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Some of the Londinium Self-Salvation Corps volunteered to join our team.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Yes, tallying up the remnants of the various ducal forces we've gathered, refugees who want to join the fight, and these militiamen from the Self-Salvation Corps, we have the strength of roughly six or seven platoons.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Siege, we'd best formally establish the military structure of the Exemplars. Appointing officers such that our chain of command can...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Lieutenant Shearer, this team is not a true military unit. It is not the Victorian Army.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: True, we have some soldiers...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But aside from you and the remnants of Duke Windermere's forces led by Delphine, the rest are ordinary folk who want to fight. Workers, farmers, merchants, and of course, street ruffians.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Should we forcibly incorporate them into one or two combat units, arm them, and subordinate them to officers, then what is the difference between us and the dukes?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Exemplars is a fine name, but I believe it should bring the people nothing but hope.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Or to speak less grandly, it should bring the people something intangible, the likes of which the dukes' high-speed battleships can't bring.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Which is to say...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Exemplars should not be a heroic force captained by the heir to the throne wielding the Realmblade. I'm rather repulsed by such titles.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: But then, how are we to organize our combat operations?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Speaking of combat operations, a considerable portion of our team has not undergone any regular military training.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: When in Londinium, do as the Londiniers do, eh?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Just as we did in Chetleigh, just as the Self-Salvation Corps did in Londinium.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We're killing the Sarkaz in our familiar way, with our familiar friends.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: ...No offense, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: None taken. No harm done.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The ritual has been terminated, but the blessing bestowed on the Sarkaz blood has not completely gone with it.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Over Londinium way... ancient witchcraft stirs.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Our mortal enemy operates with unknown purpose, but the urgency they reveal presents an opportunity for a breakthrough.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We will be extra cautious.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Let's snatch that bone back.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The plan was a success. The Victorian attack did distract a portion of the forces here.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We're in, and it's here.

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: You, are you the Sarkaz from last time? How did you—

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: Is this a joint attack with the Victorians?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Spine Guardian
steps.text: Kill the traitors! Kill these Sarkaz traitors!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ulšulah isn't here to welcome us.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Logos guessed right. Looks like she's too busy.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah—You didn't let me come in last time. This sucker's huge!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Can I blow it into two halves?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No, stay with the team.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Get onto its spine and seize its operator.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, I feel it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's here.

a.text: I follow the Banshee's gaze to the shadow cast on the rock.
A hint of blood invades my nostrils.
Does this skeleton... have veins?
